name: machship-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the Machship freight management platform

machship_api_token.title: Machship API Token
machship_api_token.description: Needed for every tool call. Your Machship API token (Settings → API → Generate token)

machship_api_url.title: Machship API URL
machship_api_url.description: Override the Machship API base URL (default: https://live.machship.com)

tools.name: machship_ping
tools.description:
Determines the current user's login status and retrieves session properties from Machship.
Use this to verify authentication is working and to get the current user/company context.

tools.name: machship_get_attachment
tools.description:
Downloads raw attachment file bytes from Machship by attachment ID.
Returns base64-encoded file content.

tools.name: machship_get_attachment_pod_report
tools.description: Downloads a Proof of Delivery (POD) report that includes attachment and consignment details.

tools.name: machship_get_attachments_by_consignment_ids
tools.description: Downloads attachments for up to 40 consignments in bulk (returned as zip).

tools.name: machship_upload_attachments
tools.description: Uploads one or more attachments to Machship.

tools.name: machship_get_carrier_invoices
tools.description: Returns basic carrier invoice information (max 100 records per call).

tools.name: machship_get_carrier_invoice_entries
tools.description: Gets carrier invoice line entries with optional status filtering.

tools.name: machship_update_reprice_consignment
tools.description:
Updates consignment items on a carrier invoice entry and triggers repricing.
Use for reconciling carrier invoice discrepancies.

tools.name: machship_attempt_auto_reconciliation
tools.description: Attempts automatic reconciliation of carrier invoices based on configured carrier thresholds.

tools.name: machship_upload_commercial_invoice
tools.description:
Uploads one or more commercial invoice files for a consignment (for international shipments).
Files are provided as base64-encoded content.

tools.name: machship_get_companies
tools.description: Returns all companies accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: machship_get_company_carriers
tools.description:
Returns all available carriers, carrier accounts, and freight services for a company.
Call this before creating consignments or quotes to discover which services and accounts are available.

tools.name: machship_get_item
tools.description: Returns a single saved item (product/SKU) with its dimensions by ID.

tools.name: machship_get_items
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of saved items for a company (max 200 per request).

tools.name: machship_get_item_by_sku
tools.description: Returns a saved item matching the given SKU for a company.

tools.name: machship_get_item_complex
tools.description: Returns a single complex item (with detailed dimensions/packaging data) by ID.

tools.name: machship_get_items_complex
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of complex items for a company (max 200 per request).

tools.name: machship_get_item_complex_by_sku
tools.description: Returns a complex item (detailed dimensions) by SKU for a company.

tools.name: machship_create_item_complex
tools.description: Creates a new complex item (product/SKU with detailed packaging info) for a company.

tools.name: machship_delete_item
tools.description: Deletes a saved item from a company. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: machship_get_items_by_skus
tools.description:
Returns a list of saved items matching any of the supplied SKUs (standard items only, max 100 SKUs).
SKUs that don't match any item are silently omitted — compare returned Sku values against your input to detect misses.

tools.name: machship_get_company_location
tools.description: Returns details for a single company location (warehouse, store, depot).

tools.name: machship_get_company_locations
tools.description: Returns all locations (warehouses, stores, depots) for a given company.

tools.name: machship_create_company_location
tools.description: Creates a new company location (warehouse, store, depot pickup point).

tools.name: machship_edit_company_location
tools.description: Edits an existing company location.

tools.name: machship_get_permanent_pickups
tools.description: Gets all permanent scheduled pickups configured for a company location.

tools.name: machship_add_permanent_pickups
tools.description: Adds permanent scheduled pickups to a company location.

tools.name: machship_get_consignment
tools.description: Returns full details for a single consignment by ID.

tools.name: machship_get_consignments_by_ids
tools.description: Returns details for multiple consignments by their IDs (max 100 per request).

tools.name: machship_get_consignments_by_reference1
tools.description: Finds consignments by their Reference 1 field (order number, etc). Max 10 per request.

tools.name: machship_get_consignments_by_reference2
tools.description: Finds consignments by their Reference 2 field. Max 10 per request.

tools.name: machship_get_consignments_by_carrier_id
tools.description: Finds consignments by carrier's own consignment/tracking ID. Max 10 per request.

tools.name: machship_get_consignment_statuses
tools.description: Returns tracking/delivery statuses for a batch of consignments, with optional date filter.

tools.name: machship_update_consignment_statuses
tools.description: Manually updates tracking statuses for consignments (e.g. mark as delivered).

tools.name: machship_get_unmanifested_consignments
tools.description: Returns consignments that have been created but not yet manifested (booked with carrier).

tools.name: machship_get_active_consignments
tools.description: Returns all active (in-transit) consignments for a company.

tools.name: machship_get_all_consignments
tools.description: Returns all consignments for a company with date range and status filtering.

tools.name: machship_get_recent_consignments
tools.description: Returns consignments created or updated within a UTC date range. Ideal for sync/polling workflows.

tools.name: machship_get_completed_consignments
tools.description: Returns completed (delivered) consignments within a date range (max 2000 results).

tools.name: machship_create_consignment
tools.description: Creates a new unmanifested consignment in Machship. This is the core operation for booking freight.

tools.name: machship_create_consignment_with_complex_items
tools.description: Creates a consignment using complex item definitions (with detailed packaging/dangerous goods data).

tools.name: machship_create_consignment_existing_items
tools.description: Creates a consignment using previously saved company items (by item ID / SKU).

tools.name: machship_edit_consignment
tools.description: Edits an existing unmanifested (not yet booked) consignment. Cannot edit manifested consignments.

tools.name: machship_delete_consignments
tools.description: Deletes multiple unmanifested consignments. Cannot delete manifested consignments.

tools.name: machship_search_consignments
tools.description: Searches consignments by reference numbers (Reference 1, Reference 2, or carrier IDs).

tools.name: machship_get_consignment_creation_settings
tools.description: Returns settings and defaults needed for creating consignments for a company (required fields, defaults, etc.).

tools.name: machship_get_consignment_attachments
tools.description: Returns attachment metadata (not file contents) for a consignment.

tools.name: machship_update_despatch_dates
tools.description: Updates despatch dates and estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a set of consignments.

tools.name: machship_get_consignment_by_pending_id
tools.description: Get consignment details (if it exists) using a pending consignment ID that has been transformed (linked) into a consignment.

tools.name: machship_get_consignment_for_clone
tools.description: Get the details of an existing consignment in a format that can be passed directly to the createConsignmentWithComplexItems endpoint to create a copy.

tools.name: machship_get_unmanifested_consignment_for_edit
tools.description: Get an unmanifested consignment in the same format required to perform an update via the editUnmanifestedConsignment endpoint.

tools.name: machship_get_consignments_by_pending_ids
tools.description: Get consignment details for multiple consignments using Pending Consignment IDs as the lookup. Maximum of 100 consignments per request.

tools.name: machship_group_consignments_for_consolidation
tools.description:
Automatically groups consignments into consolidation groups based on options (carrier, route, etc.).
Returns groups without actually consolidating — preview step before consolidation.

tools.name: machship_perform_consolidation
tools.description:
Consolidates a set of consignments into consolidated shipments.
This merges multiple consignments into fewer shipment units for carrier efficiency.

tools.name: machship_group_and_perform_consolidation
tools.description: Groups and consolidates consignments in a single operation (combines grouping + performing).

tools.name: machship_get_custom_schemas
tools.description:
Returns all custom schemas defined in the Machship organisation.
Custom schemas extend Machship entities with additional fields.

tools.name: machship_get_custom_schema
tools.description: Returns a specific custom schema by its DotNet class ID.

tools.name: machship_create_custom_schema
tools.description: Creates a new custom schema to extend Machship entities with additional fields.

tools.name: machship_update_custom_schema
tools.description: Updates an existing custom schema by its DotNet class ID.

tools.name: machship_delete_custom_schema
tools.description: Deletes a custom schema by its DotNet class ID. This is irreversible.

tools.name: machship_get_posted_invoices
tools.description: Returns posted financial invoices within an optional date range (max 100 per call).

tools.name: machship_get_invoice_by_document_number
tools.description: Returns a specific financial invoice by document number, with optional PDF download.

tools.name: machship_get_identities
tools.description:
Get all identities owned by an organisation, with details on which companies they are linked to.
Requires administrator access to the organisation.

tools.name: machship_get_identity
tools.description: Get the identity with the given ID.

tools.name: machship_get_available_roles
tools.description: Get all roles that are available to assign to users of a certain company.

tools.name: machship_create_identities
tools.description:
Create identities in MachShip and assign companies and roles. All identities must belong to the same identityProvider and organisation.
Requires administrator access.

tools.name: machship_update_identity
tools.description: Updates properties on an identity. All fields except password are required; omitted fields are set to null.

tools.name: machship_delete_identities
tools.description: Delete the identities with the given IDs. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: machship_disable_identities
tools.description: Disable the identities with the given IDs, preventing them from logging in.

tools.name: machship_reenable_identities
tools.description: Re-enable previously disabled identities, restoring login access.

tools.name: machship_link_identities_to_companies
tools.description:
Assign companies and roles to identities to give them access to the system.
Requires administrator access.

tools.name: machship_unlink_identities_from_companies
tools.description: Remove company access from identities. Each entry specifies an identity and the company to revoke access from.

tools.name: machship_return_identity_public_keys
tools.description:
Get the public keys of the supplied identities. These keys can be used by a linked organisation to grant
those identities access to companies in their organisation.
Requires administrator access.

tools.name: machship_get_identity_provider
tools.description: Get a specific identity provider by ID.

tools.name: machship_get_identity_providers_for_company
tools.description: Get all identity providers associated with a specific company.

tools.name: machship_get_identity_providers_for_logged_user
tools.description: Returns all identity providers for the current user's organisation. No parameters required.

tools.name: machship_get_identity_providers_for_organisation
tools.description: Returns all identity providers for the specified organisation.

tools.name: machship_get_consignment_label_pdf
tools.description: Returns the consignment label as a PDF (base64 or file bytes).

tools.name: machship_get_item_label_pdf
tools.description: Returns item/package labels for a consignment as a PDF.

tools.name: machship_get_item_labels_zip
tools.description: Gets item labels as a zip file for up to 40 consignments.

tools.name: machship_get_manifest_label_pdf
tools.description: Returns the manifest document as a PDF by manifest ID.

tools.name: machship_get_manifest_label_pdf_by_consignment
tools.description: Returns the manifest PDF for the manifest associated with a given consignment.

tools.name: machship_get_commercial_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Returns the commercial invoice PDF for a consignment (used for international shipments).

tools.name: machship_get_dangerous_goods_pdf
tools.description: Returns the dangerous goods declaration document PDF for a consignment.

tools.name: machship_send_labels_to_printer
tools.description: Sends labels directly to a configured printer in Machship.

tools.name: machship_group_consignments_for_printing
tools.description: Groups consignments for batch label printing and returns print groups.

tools.name: machship_get_consignment_pdf_file_info
tools.description: Returns file metadata (name, size, URL) for the consignment label PDF without downloading it.

tools.name: machship_get_item_pdf_file_info
tools.description: Returns file metadata for the item/package label PDF without downloading it.

tools.name: machship_get_manifest_pdf_file_info
tools.description: Returns file metadata for the manifest PDF without downloading it.

tools.name: machship_get_dangerous_goods_pdf_file_info
tools.description: Returns file metadata for the dangerous goods declaration PDF without downloading it.

tools.name: machship_get_mo41_document_pdf
tools.description: Returns the MO41 document PDF for a consignment (used for specific carrier compliance documents).

tools.name: machship_get_mo41_document_pdf_file_info
tools.description: Returns file metadata for the MO41 document PDF without downloading it.

tools.name: machship_get_special_instructions_pdf
tools.description: Returns the special instructions document PDF for a consignment.

tools.name: machship_return_item_pdfs_for_consignments
tools.description: Returns item labels as a zip for up to 40 consignments (POST variant — use this when passing a body payload is preferred over query string).

tools.name: machship_search_locations
tools.description:
Returns up to 10 Machship locations matching a suburb or postcode search string.
Use this to look up valid delivery/pickup locationIds before creating consignments.

tools.name: machship_get_locations_exact
tools.description:
Returns locations that exactly match provided suburb/postcode combinations.
Supports multiple location lookups in one call.

tools.name: machship_get_locations_with_options
tools.description: Returns locations with additional search options/filters applied.

tools.name: machship_get_manifests
tools.description:
Returns a paginated list of manifests for a company (max 200 per call).
A manifest represents a carrier pickup booking for a group of consignments.

tools.name: machship_group_all_for_manifest
tools.description: Groups ALL unmanifested consignments for a company into manifest groups (preview before manifesting).

tools.name: machship_group_consignments_for_manifest
tools.description: Groups a specific set of consignments into manifest groups (preview before manifesting).

tools.name: machship_manifest_consignments
tools.description:
Books/manifests consignments with the carrier — creates the pickup booking and generates tracking numbers.
This is the final step in the consignment workflow before physical pickup.

tools.name: machship_rebook_manifest_pickup
tools.description: Rebooks the carrier pickup for an existing manifest (e.g. missed pickup or changed schedule).

tools.name: machship_get_consignment_notes
tools.description: Returns all notes attached to a consignment (internal comments, delivery instructions, etc.).

tools.name: machship_get_organisation_links
tools.description: Returns all links (partnerships/integrations) that exist for an organisation.

tools.name: machship_get_linked_from_organisations
tools.description: Returns all organisations that have linked INTO this organisation (suppliers, partners).

tools.name: machship_get_linked_to_organisations
tools.description: Returns all organisations this organisation has linked TO (customers, subsidiaries).

tools.name: machship_get_organisation_public_key
tools.description: Returns the public key for an organisation, used to set up inter-organisation links.

tools.name: machship_get_organisation_by_public_key
tools.description:
Validates a public key and returns the corresponding organisation details.
Use this to verify a partner's public key before linking.

tools.name: machship_add_organisation_link
tools.description: Links another organisation into yours using their public key.

tools.name: machship_remove_organisation_link
tools.description: Removes an existing link between two organisations. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: machship_reset_organisation_public_key
tools.description: Resets the public key for an organisation (generates new key). Does NOT affect existing links.

tools.name: machship_create_pending_consignment
tools.description:
Creates a pending consignment — a draft/staging consignment that hasn't been rated or assigned to a carrier yet.
Pending consignments can be converted to full consignments after quoting.

tools.name: machship_get_pending_consignment
tools.description: Returns details for a single pending consignment by ID.

tools.name: machship_get_pending_consignments_by_ids
tools.description: Returns details for multiple pending consignments by IDs (max 10 per request).

tools.name: machship_get_pending_consignments_by_reference1
tools.description: Finds pending consignments by Reference 1 field. Max 10 per request.

tools.name: machship_get_pending_consignments_by_reference2
tools.description: Finds pending consignments by Reference 2 field. Max 10 per request.

tools.name: machship_get_recent_pending_consignments
tools.description: Returns pending consignments created or updated within a UTC date range. Useful for sync workflows.

tools.name: machship_delete_pending_consignments
tools.description: Deletes one or more pending consignments.

tools.name: machship_create_quote
tools.description:
Creates a freight quote in Machship — returns available carrier rates for a shipment.
Use this to compare carrier prices and transit times before creating a consignment.

tools.name: machship_create_quote_complex_items
tools.description: Creates a freight quote using complex item definitions (detailed packaging, dangerous goods, serialisation data).

tools.name: machship_get_quotes
tools.description: Returns all quotes for a given company.

tools.name: machship_get_quote
tools.description: Returns full details for a single quote by ID, including all carrier rate options.

tools.name: machship_get_routes
tools.description:
Returns a list of available freight routes and carrier services for a single shipment request.
Use this to find all carrier options (rates, ETAs) before creating a consignment.

tools.name: machship_get_routes_batch
tools.description:
Returns available routes for multiple shipment requests in a single call.
Efficient for bulk rate shopping across multiple shipments.

tools.name: machship_get_routes_complex_items
tools.description: Returns available routes for a shipment with complex item definitions (dangerous goods, specialised packaging).
